source.title: Replication data for: Laboratory-Scale Experiments on Ignited Hydrogen Jets: Flame Acceleration and Overpressure Analysis

access_audit.access_interpretation: The public metadata and small aggregate matrix were inspected. The 39 raw time-series CSV files were not downloaded or scored. Because aggregate outcomes were already visible, a future replay is exploratory unless a new pre-access protocol is frozen before raw-file access and the prior exposure is disclosed.

documented_channels: hydrogen mass-flow derived from experimental pressure
measurement_contract.environment: laboratory-scale open atmospheric delayed-ignition under-expanded hydrogen jet
measurement_contract.exact_header_and_clock_alignment: must be verified from selected raw CSV files before replay

replay_protocol_requirement.case_selection: declare eligibility and an experiment-level calibration/holdout split before downloading any selected raw CSV
replay_protocol_requirement.parameter_policy: no case-specific fitting, time warping, outcome-based threshold changes or post-hoc source-term selection
replay_protocol_requirement.promotion_rule: do not promote to runtime or claim outdoor HRS safety distance unless a frozen component screen passes and its domain boundary is recorded

claim_boundary: This is a public laboratory-scale ignited-jet component dataset candidate. It can support delayed-ignition, flame-acceleration and overpressure component analysis after a frozen replay, but it does not validate an HRS dispenser, station control, vehicle fueling loop, ESD sequence, field safety distance or SAGA operator effectiveness.
